question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is: **'seen'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate option to fill the blank is: **'seen'.**
 
• The word '**seen**' is **verb** here and it is the **Past Participle **form of the word **'See'.**
 
• The original word '**see**' means to observe something.
 
 
• **Example**: *I have seen the Portrait.*
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **'Option 1'.**

**Complete Sentence__: **Many parents think of overweight children as 'cute' and cuddly. However, obesity must not be (1)__ seen __as a healthy sign. (2)________ obese children grow up, they will be more prone (3)____________ health problems like high blood pressure (4)________ diabetes. Today, overweight children are becoming a common (5)___________ in many countries.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2**: **'casted'** means an act of throwing something forcefully.(ढला हुआ)
 
• **Option 3**: '**keen'** means having or showing eagerness or enthusiasm.(उत्सुक)
 
• **Option 4**: '**wasted**' means used or expended carelessly.(बर्बाद)
